violations.text: Various items were observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit in the open air cooler next to the prepared foods section. Foods were observed overfilled in the unit/stored on top of the air vents. Staff instructed to store less product in the unit away from vents to promote proper airflow. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Pizza, chicken sandwiches, and other hot foods packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, major allergens, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
